name: Business Meeting
description: A structured gathering of professionals to share information, make decisions, or solve problems

structure.body: Organized discussion of agenda items with time allocation
structure.closing: Summary of decisions, action items, and next steps

visual_aids.recommendations: Simple slides or handouts for complex information only

best_practices: Distribute agenda in advance with time allocations
Keep discussion focused on agenda items
Document decisions and action items with owners
Follow up with meeting notes and next steps

audience_expectations.content: Prepared, concise, and relevant to meeting purpose
audience_expectations.materials: Necessary references or data to support discussion

status_update.description: Regular meeting to share progress updates

decision_making.description: Meeting to reach consensus on important matters
decision_making.key_differences: More debate and deliberation, clear decision framework

brainstorming.key_differences: Less structure, emphasis on psychological safety and creativity

preparation_checklist: Review previous meeting notes if applicable
Plan facilitation approach for key discussions
